self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Secrets of Frost, Silver-Tinged Blood Pact: the wielder gains +48 EM per Cryo party member and +9.6% ATK per Electro party member (up to 4 providers, counting the wielder). Under Radiance: Stellar Glimmer it becomes +40 EM and +12% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG per Cryo OR Electro member instead. This entry is the Cryo half of the base mode (EM); pair it with bloodPactElectroMembers, and do not combine either with the Radiance entry.

R5 Secrets of Frost, Silver-Tinged Blood Pact: the wielder gains +48 EM per Cryo party member and +9.6% ATK per Electro party member (up to 4 providers, counting the wielder). Under Radiance: Stellar Glimmer it becomes +40 EM and +12% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG per Cryo OR Electro member instead. This entry is the Electro half of the base mode (ATK); pair it with bloodPactCryoMembers, and do not combine either with the Radiance entry.

R5 Secrets of Frost, Silver-Tinged Blood Pact: the wielder gains +48 EM per Cryo party member and +9.6% ATK per Electro party member (up to 4 providers, counting the wielder). Under Radiance: Stellar Glimmer it becomes +40 EM and +12% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG per Cryo OR Electro member instead. This entry is the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer mode: count every Cryo and Electro member together. Exclusive with the two base-mode entries.

source.note: 7.1 weapon, added 2026-09-22 (release day) from nanoka 7.1 data; neither Amber nor GO carry it yet. Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (the derivation validated against the existing seed files for the 7.0 batch). Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1). Split into three entries because the base mode needs two independent counts.
